description: M4-09: exact fast lexicon fallback (PronLexicon.nearest, NumPy Levenshtein per length bucket; nearest_bruteforce = reference) and time-budgeted prewarm (CTCBeamSpec.prewarm_budget_s, PhonemeWordDecoder.warm). Equality of nearest() on all B2T test queries + synthetic queries; equality of final decisions vs M4-06 (ours and published gate); end-of-utterance and push latency. CPU only. Main run with gc.freeze() after setup.

b2t.data: Brain-to-Text '25 copy task (Card et al. 2024, T15, CC0): the 816 split-A test trials as full-precision NTS JSON Lines written by M4-06
b2t.decoder: as M4-08: phoneme CTC prefix beam (vector, beam 64, n_best 20, no LM) -> PhonemeWordDecoder (CMUdict, word unigram, char 6-gram)
b2t.caches: word decoder caches cleared at the start of each condition, kept across the trials of a condition (as in a live session)
b2t.gc_note: Main run: gc.collect() + gc.freeze() after setup and before each condition; automatic GC off during a condition, one gc.collect() before each utterance (idle point, not timed; its time is reported as gc_idle_collect_ms). Earlier runs: results/b2t-gc-default.json (default GC, budgets 1/2/3 ms: a gen-2 collection took up to 0.3 s inside a push) and results/b2t-gc-freeze-once.json (freeze once after setup: gen-2 pauses up to 0.25 s remained). A partial third run (freeze before each condition, automatic GC on) still showed 60-70 ms push maxima in the search-only conditions and was stopped.

timing: time.perf_counter around each StreamingTrustLayer.push (M4-08 harness); end of utterance = push of the end event; CPU per utterance = sum of all push times of the utterance
